proposed.explanation: While visually dramatic, the design is driven by structural logic, not postmodern representational reference. High-Tech is more than material selection; it concerns structural expression as design methodology. The trusses are primary structural system; they are not decorative but essential to building behavior. This precisely: structural logic becomes primary design generator. Suspension structure is not arbitrary aesthetic choice but results from optimization for column-free office floors and public plaza. The form is structurally honest—trusses are visible because they are actual load-bearing systems, and this visibility generates spectacular but functionally-justified architecture.
